name: com.palletdimensions/freight-reference
title: palletdimensions.com freight reference
description: Read-only freight data: pallet sizes, NMFC class, trailer and container fits, DIM weight, Ti×Hi.

tools.name: freight_class
tools.description: Freight class for one LTL handling unit from its size and weight, under the NMFC 13-sub density scale (effective July 19, 2025). weight is the weight of ONE piece, not the total; pieces (default 1) multiplies the cube and the weight. Dimensions default to inches and weight to pounds; set dimUnit to cm and/or weightUnit to kg for metric. roundUp (default false, as the calculator) rounds each side up to the next whole inch when true.

length.description: Length of one handling unit, pallet included, at its greatest point, in dimUnit: 1–1000 in or 2.54–2540 cm

width.description: Width of one handling unit, in dimUnit (same range as length)

height.description: Height of one handling unit, pallet included, in dimUnit (same range as length)

weight.description: Weight of ONE piece, in weightUnit (per piece, not the total): 0.1–100000 lb

pieces.description: Identical pieces in the handling unit

roundUp.description: Round each side up to the next whole inch

tools.name: pallets_per_trailer
tools.description: How many pallets fit on the floor of a trailer, loaded straight, turned, as the best mix or as side-by-side pinwheel lanes, and stacked when loadHeight and stackable are given. Choose equipment from list_equipment and pallet from its ids, or give palletLength and palletWidth in inches for a custom size. weight is the weight of ONE pallet in pounds and is checked against the trailer payload.

pallet.description: Pallet id. Ignored when palletLength and palletWidth are given

palletLength.description: Custom pallet length, in inches (12–120). Give with palletWidth

palletWidth.description: Custom pallet width, in inches (12–120). Give with palletLength

loadHeight.description: Loaded pallet height in inches (1–144), used when stackable is true

weight.description: Weight of ONE pallet in pounds (0.1–10000)

stackable.description: Whether the freight can be double-stacked

tools.name: calculate_cube
tools.description: Total volume of up to 20 lines of identical pieces, in cubic feet, cubic metres, cubic inches, cubic yards and litres. Each item has length, width, height in unit (in, ft, yd, mm, cm or m; default in) and quantity (default 1). When every item has a weight, also returns total weight, density in lb/ft³ and kg/m³, and ocean weight/measurement (the larger of m³ and tonnes). weight is per piece unless weightBasis is line. rounding (default exact) can round each side up or to the nearest whole inch first.

length.description: Length of one piece, in unit

width.description: Width of one piece, in unit

height.description: Height of one piece, in unit

weight.description: Weight in weightUnit, per piece unless weightBasis is line. Give it on every item or on none

rounding.description: exact, ceil-in (each side up to a whole inch) or nearest-in

tools.name: calculate_dim_weight
tools.description: Dimensional (DIM) weight of one package in pounds and kilograms: length × width × height in inches, rounded as the service rules say, divided by that service divisor. service picks the carrier and rate (default ups-daily): ups-daily = UPS UPS packages, Daily Rates; ups-retail-domestic = UPS UPS domestic packages, Retail Rates; ups-retail-export = UPS UPS export packages, Retail Rates; fedex-packages = FedEx FedEx U.S. and international package services and Express Freight (not International Deferred Freight or One Rate); fedex-intl-deferred = FedEx FedEx International Deferred Freight; fedex-ground-economy = FedEx FedEx Ground Economy at 1 lb or more, including Bound Printed Matter, Media and Returns; usps-priority = USPS USPS Priority Mail, retail, to Zones 1-9. Services whose checked sources state no rounding rule are left unrounded. USPS retail Priority Mail applies dimensional weight only above its volume floor. Give actualWeight to compare it with the dimensional weight; this tool does not work out a charge.

tools.name: calculate_ti_hi
tools.description: Cartons per layer (Ti), layers per pallet (Hi) and cartons per pallet for one carton size, the load height and the total weight. Ti is the best of an all-one-way pattern, an all-turned pattern and two two-block mixes; the carton height stays vertical. All lengths are in unit (in or cm). Choose pallet from list_equipment ids (default 48x40) or give palletLength and palletWidth. overhang is how far the load may hang past each pallet edge (default 0). Give maxHeight (total load height, pallet included) with deckHeight (the empty pallet height) for Hi; without them only Ti is returned. Neither is assumed: the page offers sourced starting values. Give cartonWeight (and palletWeight) for the total weight. Capacity ratings for a 48 × 40 pallet appear only as a warning.

height.description: Carton height, in unit. This side stays vertical

pallet.description: Pallet id. Ignored when palletLength and palletWidth are given

palletLength.description: Custom pallet length, in unit. Give with palletWidth

palletWidth.description: Custom pallet width, in unit. Give with palletLength

overhang.description: Overhang allowed past each pallet edge, in unit

maxHeight.description: Greatest total load height, pallet included, in unit. Give with deckHeight

deckHeight.description: Height of the empty pallet, in unit. Required with maxHeight

cartonWeight.description: Weight of one carton, in weightUnit

palletWeight.description: Weight of the empty pallet, in weightUnit

tools.name: list_equipment
tools.description: Lists the trailers and pallet ids that pallets_per_trailer accepts, with the inside dimensions it loads against.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Lists the published datasets with their ids, row counts and verified row counts. Use get_dataset to read one.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Returns the verified rows of one published dataset, with their sources. Unverified rows are never returned; the result says how many were left out.
